creator: itsmariahbrunner
title: Comparison of four consumer AI agents (Meta Muse, ChatGPT Dots, Grok Bot, Avori) and when to use each; creator built Avori

tools.name: Muse (Meta)
tools.detail: Free; US/Canada only; good for Instagram/Meta ads users; e.g. review Instagram insights

tools.name: Dots (ChatGPT)
tools.detail: Agent mode inside ChatGPT, builds on existing chat context; requires Pro plan; creator found it slow/buggy; connects Google Calendar, Google Drive, GitHub, Charts

tools.name: Grok Bot (xAI)
tools.detail: Multiple agents, each with jobs; demonstrate a process and save it as a skill; SuperGrok $30/month includes Grok Bot access, Grok 4.6 model; watch usage costs

tools.name: Avori
tools.detail: Creator's own product: team of proactive agents shared with teammates; any model (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini); model picker shows Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5

claims: Muse: start here if brand new to agents; free; US and Canada only
Dots: use if ChatGPT is where you already work; Pro plan required; slow and buggy workflows in creator's experience
Grok Bot: multiple agents doing different jobs; can record a process as a skill; costs add up fast; included in SuperGrok $30/month
Avori: build a shareable team of proactive agents, any model; 'making AI a multiplayer game'; creator built it for her own business problems
how_to_steps: New to agents: try Muse free and give it a first job like reviewing Instagram insights
ChatGPT Pro users: enable Dots and build on existing context
Multi-agent needs: Grok Bot, demonstrate a process to save it as a skill, monitor usage
Teams: Avori, build agents and share them with teammates
on_screen_only: Title card 'Dots vs. Muse vs. Grok Bot vs. Avori: Which Should You Try?'
Muse widget: 'Muse is checking weather'; 'personal AI agent' Instagram overlay
Dots connectors list: Google Calendar, Google Drive, GitHub, Charts
Grok Bot 'Give each Bot a job' page and pricing card 'SuperGrok $30/month billed monthly: Grok Bot access, Grok 4.6 model, higher rate limits, Expert, image and video generation, connectors'

Avori UI 'What should we tackle today?' with model dropdown listing OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5 selected, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5), Google, Meta
Guide page 'DOTS: IF YOU LIVE IN CHATGPT' (the comparison guide offered via comment)
cta: Comment 'compare' (on IG @Itsmariahbrunner) to get the full comparison guide

relevance.why: Consumer/marketing-oriented agent products, and the strongest pitch is for the creator's own Avori. Minor value as a competitor scan and as a note that consumer agent apps now expose Claude models (Fable 5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5) in pickers.

implement_score.why: Not worth adopting; our agent work runs in Claude Code/Agent SDK. Possibly glance at Grok Bot's 'demonstrate a process, save as skill' UX as a product-design reference.

verify: Do Meta Muse, ChatGPT Dots and Grok Bot exist as described (Oct 2026), and are the plan requirements accurate?
